steps.subject: The story behind the story
steps.body:
Hi {{contact_name}},

You might be wondering — why write about space colonies?

I worked at NASA during the Apollo era. I saw what human beings could achieve when they set their minds to something impossible. The No Blue Sky series is my way of asking: what's the next impossible thing?

Lunar colonies. Martian settlements. Generational ships. These aren't science fiction anymore — they're engineering challenges waiting to be solved.

Read the series description here: [link]

Best,
Bob Mills
